gripOrHq.title: Priority Wreck
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

gripOrHq.title: Armored Fridge
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put seven Ablative counters on Armored Fridge when it is installed. When the last Ablative counter has been removed, trash Armored Fridge.
Ablative counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

gripOrHq.title: Weather-to-Finance Pipe
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [4].

gripOrHq.title: Shield
gripOrHq.rulesText: Prevents up to 2 Net damage each turn.

gripOrHq.title: Jackhammer
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[0]: Break wall subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.
Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Jackhammer, lose 1 credit, if you can, from a stealth card.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

heapOrArchives.title: Gideon’s Pawnshop
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your trash for a card and bring it into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: If You Want It Done Right...
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Look through the top five cards of your stack. Bring one of those cards into your hand, and arrange the rest in any order you choose.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

rig.title: Skivviss
rig.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Skivviss counter. Each Skivviss counter requires the Corp to draw one extra card at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rig.title: Pile Driver
rig.rulesText: [3]: Break up to four wall subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you use Pile Driver’s break-walls subroutine, lose a total of [3] from stealth cards.

rig.title: Evil Twin
rig.rulesText:
[3]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.
Prevents up to 2 net and/or brain damage total each turn.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

scoreArea.title: Project Venice
scoreArea.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Downsizing
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: Bizarre Encryption Scheme
root.rulesText: Bizarre Encryption Scheme may only be installed in a subsidiary data fort. Runner does not score any agenda (or agendas) that he or she accesses from this fort; return the agenda to the fort instead. Runner scores the agenda at the start of his or her next turn if it is still in the fort.

root.title: Systematic Layoffs
root.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.
